name: OpusFile

source.verification: Official Xiph.Org release tarball, downloaded on 2026-11-23; its SHA-256 matches downloads.xiph.org/releases/opus/SHA256SUMS.txt. Imported files are opusfile.h, the decoding sources without HTTP and certificate support (http.c, wincerts.c), and COPYING.

notes: Ogg Opus file decoder for the audio importer (Docs/Design/AudioSystem section 3.29). Developer only: AudioTools links it.
OpusFile.Build.cs adds the Ogg and Opus include directories, because opusfile.h includes ogg/ogg.h and opus_multistream.h; consumers link OpusFile, Opus and Ogg.

The UTF-8 file name conversion in stream.c (Windows op_fopen path) combines the fourth byte with & where | looks intended; the parentheses added by Rocks.patch keep the upstream behaviour. AudioTools opens memory streams only.

modifications.reason: Add parentheses around the subtractions under >> (-Wshift-op-parentheses, nine places); the C precedence and results are unchanged.

Add parentheses around the & terms inside | (-Wbitwise-op-parentheses, three places; precedence and results unchanged); define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN only when it is not defined yet, because the Rocks build defines it on the command line (-Wmacro-redefined); and replace the Microsoft CRT calls deprecated under -Wdeprecated-declarations, which the 4996 pragma of internal.h would otherwise hide (the directive probe compiles without it): _wfopen with _wfsopen(..., _SH_DENYNO) (same sharing), fdopen with _fdopen on Windows, and _wfreopen with _wfreopen_s (same reopen, without sharing). AudioTools opens memory streams only.
Add parentheses around && inside || (-Wlogical-op-parentheses, two places); the C precedence and results are unchanged.
